Putting \(z=y\):
\[
x*(y*y)=(x*y)+y.
\]
Since \(y*y=0\), we get
\[
x*0=(x*y)+y \quad\Rightarrow\quad x*y=x*0-y.
\]
Then
\[
x*(y*z)=x*0-(y*z),
\]
while
\[
(x*y)+z=x*0-y+z.
\]
Equating:
\[
x*0-(y*z)=x*0-y+z \quad\Rightarrow\quad y*z=y-z.
\]
Thus
\[
1993*1935=1993-1935=58.
\]

\[
\boxed{58}
\]
